description_en: Call `DescribeNetworkPeerConnections` to query network peer connections
description_zh: 调用DescribeNetworkPeerConnections接口查询网络对等连接
name: DescribeNetworkPeerConnections

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network peer connection
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ENS node
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the network peer connection
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the networks involved in the connection. The query does not distinguish between the requester and accepter
parameters.help_zh: 根据两端网络ID过滤，不区分发起端和接收端
parameters.name: network_ids

parameters.help_en: The page number for the returned results. Default: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default: 10. Valid values: 10 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。默认值：10，取值：10~100
parameters.name: page_size
